message: Last week, we had a surprise blackout, and let me tell you, our family group chat lit up brighter than any flashlight! 💡 My sister started sending funny memes about being ‘off the grid,’ while my mom was sharing her secret stash of snacks. It was a good reminder that keeping our phones charged and having a power bank ready can really help us stay connected, even when the lights go out. Anyone else have fun blackout stories or tips to share?
